reserveReview.rationale: Historical weights, composition date and review start are unchanged. Handler 5 is resolved through the issuer frontend's underlying call-proxy (0x6894ae31cae97f228590f6dc7bbea7449f4db980): at Bifrost block 39083783, getERC20Addr() and getErc20Addr() return 0x84122a4a75bfe65ef455dba5f6d43d61359ca77e (Unified JPYC). Official bridge pairs bind that representation to Ethereum/Polygon 0xe7c3d8c9a439fede00d2600032d5db0be71c3c29. JPYC Inc.'s 2025-10-28 official security notice, retrieved 2026-10-20, independently identifies that exact underlying address as its current JPYC on both networks, matching tracked jpyc-jpyc rather than the differently addressed prepaid token. The collateral dependency now follows that exact underlying identity; it does not confer a direct issuer claim on the Bifrost representation. Whole-position bridge exit and USD-realization timing remain unknown. Source-scoped correction: an absence of tracked linkage was not supported once the issuer's exact-address source was considered; no historical quantity or review age is renewed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: BTCFi current market API positive deposit_value across handlers, captured 2026-09-04 and normalized over the $8,917,531.02 positive-deposit total; the historical handler 5 weight is preserved while its previously unknown identity is classified separately.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All historical collateral categories have exact technical identities. Unified JPYC is linked to tracked jpyc-jpyc through the issuer-identified underlying address, but remains exposed to Bifrost representation custody, unestablished direct holder redemption rights and an unestablished whole-position USD liquidity horizon. Metadata research does not refresh historical weights or establish full-book assurance.
